title: Flexible nanoporous activated carbon cloth for achieving high H2, CH4, and CO2 storage capacities and selective CO2/CH4 separation
material_description: CC-PNP | carbonized viscose rayon cloth decorated with polypyrrole nanoparticles (VRC-PNP impregnated with 5 wt% ZnCl2 / 5 wt% NH4Cl, carbonized at 850 °C for 1 h under N2); flexible N-doped carbon cloth, not activated
purification_method: carbonized product (CC-PNP) washed with 1.5 M HCl and DI water and dried in vacuum at 100 °C for 12 h
source_location: main-08.png (main article p. 8), Fig. 7a (77 K), series CC-PNP, closed square (adsorption) at pixel (202.0, 390.0)
notes: archive: fig7a_CC-PNP_adsorption.json; archive point index 0 (15 px). Closed symbols = adsorption (Fig. 7 caption). Marker partially hidden by overlapping symbols; value is the centroid of its visible part. Characterization from Table 2 (main-07.png): S_BET (N2, 77 K) 29 m2/g; Vtot 0.024 cm3/g (Table 2 footnote: DFT; Section 2.4 says total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 = 0.99, Gurvich rule); Vmicro 0.003 cm3/g (DR, N2); Vmeso 0.021 cm3/g (= Vtot - Vmicro); pore size 4.2/6/7.2 nm (QSDFT PSD peaks; first listed value stored as average_pore_diameter_nm). BET P/P0 range not stated. EDS composition (Table 1, at.%): C 80.37, O 4.81, N 12.93, Cl 1.12, Zn 0.78; dopant N in at.% by EDS (dopant_concentration_method other = EDS). Residual Zn 0.78 at.% (EDS; from ZnCl2 impregnation; no wt% given). H2 measurement (Section 2.5, main-03.png): Setaram PCTPro-E&E Sieverts apparatus with micro-doser; ~100 mg sample (approximate, stored as 100) degassed 12 h at 200 °C under vacuum (end pressure not stated); H2 purity 99.999%; sample cell ~0.7 mL; free-volume determination not described.
basis_evidence: "Excess H2 uptake (wt%)" (Fig. 7a axis title; Table 4 column header); not defined in the paper
measuring_lab_id: Oh group, Gyeongnam National University of Science and Technology (GNTECH)

purification_method: carbonized product (CC-PNP) washed with 1.5 M HCl and DI water and dried in vacuum at 100 °C for 12 h; after activation washed with 10 wt% HCl and DI water and dried in vacuum at 100 °C
activation_method: chemical activation: CC-PNP immersed in 30 wt% KOH solution for 1 h, dried in air, heated at 900 °C for 1 h under N2
source_location: main-08.png (main article p. 8), Fig. 7a (77 K), series C30-CC-PNP, open square (desorption) at pixel (448.7, 185.1)
notes: archive: fig7a_C30-CC-PNP_desorption_17.json (30 px). Open symbols = desorption (Fig. 7 caption); open squares overlap the filled squares, so each was digitized with a region (--roi) enclosing that one square. Characterization from Table 2 (main-07.png): S_BET (N2, 77 K) 1635 m2/g; Vtot 0.630 cm3/g (Table 2 footnote: DFT; Section 2.4 says total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 = 0.99, Gurvich rule); Vmicro 0.280 cm3/g (DR, N2); Vmeso 0.350 cm3/g (= Vtot - Vmicro); pore size 0.81/2.2 nm (QSDFT PSD peaks; first listed value stored as average_pore_diameter_nm). BET P/P0 range not stated. EDS composition (Table 1, at.%): C 79.98, O 9.27, N 10.38, Cl 0.36, Zn 0; dopant N in at.% by EDS (dopant_concentration_method other = EDS). H2 measurement (Section 2.5, main-03.png): Setaram PCTPro-E&E Sieverts apparatus with micro-doser; ~100 mg sample (approximate, stored as 100) degassed 12 h at 200 °C under vacuum (end pressure not stated); H2 purity 99.999%; sample cell ~0.7 mL; free-volume determination not described.
basis_evidence: "Excess H2 uptake (wt%)" (Fig. 7a axis title; Table 4 column header); not defined in the paper
measuring_lab_id: Oh group, Gyeongnam National University of Science and Technology (GNTECH)

purification_method: carbonized product (CC-PNP) washed with 1.5 M HCl and DI water and dried in vacuum at 100 °C for 12 h; after activation washed with 10 wt% HCl and DI water and dried in vacuum at 100 °C
activation_method: chemical activation: CC-PNP immersed in 85 wt% KOH solution for 1 h, dried in air, heated at 900 °C for 1 h under N2
source_location: main-08.png (main article p. 8), Fig. 7a (77 K), series C85-CC-PNP, closed square (adsorption) at pixel (387.5, 235.0)
notes: archive: fig7a_C85-CC-PNP_adsorption.json; archive point index 23 (18 px). Closed symbols = adsorption (Fig. 7 caption). Marker partially hidden by overlapping symbols; value is the centroid of its visible part. Characterization from Table 2 (main-07.png): S_BET (N2, 77 K) 1335 m2/g; Vtot 0.530 cm3/g (Table 2 footnote: DFT; Section 2.4 says total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 = 0.99, Gurvich rule); Vmicro 0.302 cm3/g (DR, N2); Vmeso 0.228 cm3/g (= Vtot - Vmicro); pore size 0.81/2.2 nm (QSDFT PSD peaks; first listed value stored as average_pore_diameter_nm). BET P/P0 range not stated. EDS composition (Table 1, at.%): C 84.18, O 7.96, N 7.85, Cl 0, Zn 0; dopant N in at.% by EDS (dopant_concentration_method other = EDS). H2 measurement (Section 2.5, main-03.png): Setaram PCTPro-E&E Sieverts apparatus with micro-doser; ~100 mg sample (approximate, stored as 100) degassed 12 h at 200 °C under vacuum (end pressure not stated); H2 purity 99.999%; sample cell ~0.7 mL; free-volume determination not described.

purification_method: carbonized product (CC-PNP) washed with 1.5 M HCl and DI water and dried in vacuum at 100 °C for 12 h; after activation washed with 10 wt% HCl and DI water and dried in vacuum at 100 °C
activation_method: chemical activation: CC-PNP immersed in 85 wt% KOH solution for 1 h, dried in air, heated at 900 °C for 1 h under N2
source_location: main-08.png (main article p. 8), Fig. 7a (77 K), series C85-CC-PNP, open square (desorption) at pixel (287.6, 254.0)
notes: archive: fig7a_C85-CC-PNP_desorption_08.json (30 px). Open symbols = desorption (Fig. 7 caption); open squares overlap the filled squares, so each was digitized with a region (--roi) enclosing that one square. Characterization from Table 2 (main-07.png): S_BET (N2, 77 K) 1335 m2/g; Vtot 0.530 cm3/g (Table 2 footnote: DFT; Section 2.4 says total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 = 0.99, Gurvich rule); Vmicro 0.302 cm3/g (DR, N2); Vmeso 0.228 cm3/g (= Vtot - Vmicro); pore size 0.81/2.2 nm (QSDFT PSD peaks; first listed value stored as average_pore_diameter_nm). BET P/P0 range not stated. EDS composition (Table 1, at.%): C 84.18, O 7.96, N 7.85, Cl 0, Zn 0; dopant N in at.% by EDS (dopant_concentration_method other = EDS). H2 measurement (Section 2.5, main-03.png): Setaram PCTPro-E&E Sieverts apparatus with micro-doser; ~100 mg sample (approximate, stored as 100) degassed 12 h at 200 °C under vacuum (end pressure not stated); H2 purity 99.999%; sample cell ~0.7 mL; free-volume determination not described.
basis_evidence: "Excess H2 uptake (wt%)" (Fig. 7a axis title; Table 4 column header); not defined in the paper
measuring_lab_id: Oh group, Gyeongnam National University of Science and Technology (GNTECH)
